title: 第一卷 第104章 仙国公主第一卷 第103章 龙血泄密
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: 临近傍晚时分。
天边晚霞很美。
一艘灵舟，从远处疾驰而来。
随后在林府门前，缓缓落下。
“是谁？”
林逸站在门口，满脸期待。
现在单纯靠着林氏一族，能够自保都不错了。
主要还是得靠帮手。
尤其是元婴期的帮手。
灵舟上，很快走到一道倩影。
冰如梦白衣如雪，容颜绝美。
“如梦，你来了！”
林逸满脸惊喜，连忙上前迎接。
陈刚深以为然，就拿这件事来说，他就从来觉得算是一回事，人家叶子和那个子豪的事情，都过去了一年多，都没人再提起了，说白了跟任何人都没有什么关系，怎么就非得拿出来说事了，怎么就能够造成一些影响了。
刚刚看到那一幕，这二人本是想上前帮忙，却没想到那火宗的天才竟然这般的重视卿鸿，心中介是一缩。
从今日便一直跟在卿鸿身后的几名男，此时恭敬的跪在一名面色阴冷，一袭锦衣华服的男脚下，垂着头颅，只有那个被这些男人叫做老大的男，缓缓地说着今日跟随着卿鸿所看到的一切。
几个大招纷纷失效，从重力喷涌中恢复过来的葫芦娃战队在铃木集结号令的号召之下也吹响了反攻的号角。
而纳铁也是一脸惊讶的转头看向胡梦雅，不明白她为什么会这么说。
浅儿被从住的酒店叫过来，看到自己对手戏的演员之一是王祖蓝，她也被吓了一跳，其他所有演员也都跟她差不多的反应，这部戏的b格似乎一下子也提升了很多。
盘宇鸿说到后面声音骤然提升了数倍，语气也是变得悲愤起来，想起自己这么多年居然会是自己的亲生父亲的傀儡，心中的感觉实在是太难受了，难受得让他有一种很想死的冲动。
这里根本不是什么地宫，而是真走了一个地下通道便走进了另一座山。
“我们何尝不是如此”听到他二人的诉说，火阳水淼染与土诀霜倒是一口同声的说道，难得他们有一次能够如此的默契。
“梅姐姐，你可别这么说，你这样让我的压力好大，忽然感觉自己的的责任又重了几分了！”盘宇鸿一脸郑重的对着梅雪莲道。

It's approaching evening.
The sunset on the horizon is beautiful.
A spiritual boat came speeding from a distance.
Then he slowly fell down in front of the Lin Mansion.
"Who is it?"
Lin Yi stood at the door, looking forward to it.
Now it is good to be able to protect ourselves simply by relying on the Lin family.
The main thing is to rely on helpers.
Especially the helper in the Nascent Soul stage.
On the spirit boat, a beautiful figure soon came up.
Ice is like a dream, white clothes are like snow, and the face is beautiful.
"Rumeng, you're here!"
Lin Yi's face was full of surprise and he quickly stepped forward to greet him.
Chen Gang deeply believed that, taking this matter as an example, he had never thought that it was the same thing. More than a year had passed since the incident between Ye Zi and that Zihao, and no one mentioned it again. To put it bluntly, it had nothing to do with anyone, so why did it have to be brought up to talk about it, and how could it have some impact.
After seeing that scene just now, these two people originally wanted to step forward to help, but they did not expect that the genius of the Fire Sect would pay so much attention to Qing Hong, and their hearts shrank.
Several men who had been following Qing Hong since today were kneeling respectfully at the feet of a man with a cold face and dressed in brocade clothes, with their heads hanging down. Only the man called boss by these men slowly talked about everything they had seen following Qing Hong today.
Several ultimate moves failed one after another, and the Calabash Team, which had recovered from the gravity surge, also sounded the clarion call for counterattack under Suzuki's rallying call.
Na Tie also turned to look at Hu Mengya with a surprised look on his face, not understanding why she said that.
Qian'er was called over from the hotel where she was staying. She was also shocked when she saw that one of the actors she was opposite was Wang Zulan. All the other actors had similar reactions to her. The drama's B-level seemed to have suddenly improved a lot.
Pan Yuhong's voice suddenly increased several times after speaking, and his tone also became sad and angry. Thinking that he had been his biological father's puppet for so many years, he felt so uncomfortable that it made him want to die.
This is not an underground palace at all, but an underground passage that leads to another mountain.
"Why aren't we like this?" After hearing the two of them speaking, Huoyang Shuimiaoran and Tu Jueshuang said in unison. It was rare for them to have such a tacit understanding.
"Sister Mei, please don't say that. You put so much pressure on me, and suddenly I feel that my responsibility is a little heavier!" Pan Yuhong said to Mei Xuelian solemnly.
